title: Ky Dickens' controlled telepathy tests with Mia in a rented Glendale house

tellings.quote: brought this young girl Mia up from Mexico you know most of the family didn't even speak English only her aunt Sophia did and I rented a house in Glendale California

plain: In 2023 the documentary filmmaker Ky Dickens says she brought a young girl named Mia up from Mexico and rented a house in Glendale, California, to run controlled tests of whether Mia could read minds. Dickens says most of the family spoke no English, except Mia's aunt Sophia, and a researcher named Diane Powell was also part of the story. Dickens took part herself and tells it as evidence that some children can pick up others' thoughts.
